settings.heading: We're here to help
settings.text: Questions about a product, an order or compatibility? Real people answer every message.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 3-4 business days, and you'll get a tracking number by email as soon as yours ships. Delivery options and times for your address are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is tracked. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency, and mains-powered products ship with the right plug for your delivery country. Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by the customer.

settings.question: My tracking number shows as invalid. Why?
settings.answer: Tracking numbers can take up to 48 hours to become active. If it still doesn't work after that, email support@luxedealers.com with your order number.
